subject: 飛行動力學 - 馬赫數與跨音速空氣動力學

mc_questions.zh_question: 為什麼波音 747-400 客機型 (Intercontinental) 的最大操作馬赫數 (MMO) 比貨機型 (Freighter) 還要低？
zh_options: (A) 客機型的發動機推力較小
(B) 客機型的機身結構強度較低
(C) 客機型的上層甲板較長，造成機身氣流加速較快，提早產生震波
(D) 貨機型的機身表面塗料摩擦力較小
mc_questions.en_question: Why does the Boeing 747-400 passenger version (Intercontinental) have a lower Maximum Operating Mach Number (MMO) than the freighter version?
en_options: (A) The passenger version has less engine thrust
(B) The passenger version has lower structural strength
(C) The longer upper deck of the passenger version causes faster aerodynamic acceleration over the fuselage, leading to earlier shockwave formation
(D) The freighter version has less skin friction due to its paint
mc_questions.explanation: 根據教官說明，747-400 客機型擁有較長的『駝峰』(upper deck)，這會導致機身上方的氣流產生更明顯的空氣動力加速 (Aerodynamic Acceleration)。當機身表面任一點氣流速度提早達到音速時，該機速對應的自由氣流馬赫數 (Freestream Mach) 即為臨界馬赫數 (M_crit)。由於客機加速效應較強，其 M_crit 較低，因此 MMO 也隨之設定得較低。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於臨界馬赫數 (Critical Mach Number, Mcrit) 的定義，下列敘述何者正確？
zh_options: (A) 飛機 TAS 達到音速時的馬赫數
(B) 飛機周圍氣流速度最高點首次達到音速時，所對應的飛機馬赫數 (Freestream Mach)
(C) 飛機產生阻力發散 (Drag Rise) 時的馬赫數
(D) 震波脫離 (Detachment) 機身時的馬赫數
mc_questions.en_question: Which of the following descriptions regarding Critical Mach Number (Mcrit) is correct?
en_options: (A) The Mach number when the aircraft TAS reaches the speed of sound
(B) The freestream Mach number at which the local air velocity at some point on the aircraft first reaches the local speed of sound (Mach 1.0)
(C) The Mach number when drag rise occurs
(D) The Mach number when the shockwave detaches from the airframe
mc_questions.explanation: Mcrit 是一個『自由氣流馬赫數』(Freestream Mach Number)。當飛機以某個速度飛行時，雖然飛機本身還沒超過音速，但機翼上方或機身特定部位的局部氣流 (Local Flow) 因為加速效應可能已經先達到 Mach 1.0。這個局部氣流剛達到音速的臨界點，對應的飛機馬赫數就稱為 Mcrit。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在計算局部馬赫數 (Local Mach Number) 時，除了氣流速度的改變，還必須考慮哪一個物理現象的影響？
mc_questions.en_question: When calculating the Local Mach Number, besides the change in airflow velocity, which physical phenomenon must also be considered?
mc_questions.explanation: 局部氣流在流經機身時會被擠壓並加速。擠壓過程會產生沖壓升溫 (Ram Rise)，導致該處空氣溫度升高。由於局部音速 (Local Speed of Sound) 會隨溫度升高而增加，因此計算局部馬赫數時，分母的音速數值會因為溫升而改變，不能直接用環境音速計算。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Mach number is a ratio of TAS to the local speed of sound, therefore it has {{c1::no unit}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 馬赫數是真實空速與局部音速的比值，因此它沒有單位。
cloze_items.explanation: 馬赫數是無因次量 (dimensionless)，不論是用 knots 還是 m/s 計算，比值結果都一樣。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The air that is far ahead of the aircraft and unaffected by the object is called {{c1::Freestream}} air.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 飛機前方遠處、不受飛機影響的空氣稱為『自由氣流』。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是定義飛行馬赫數 (Flight Mach Number) 的基準點。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The temperature increase caused by air being compressed as it encounters the aircraft is known as {{c1::Ram Rise}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 空氣在遇到飛機被擠壓時所產生的溫度升高現象稱為『沖壓升溫』。
cloze_items.explanation: 這會導致局部音速增加，進而影響局部馬赫數的計算。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The Maximum Operating Mach number is abbreviated as {{c1::MMO}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 最大操作馬赫數的縮寫為 MMO。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是飛機在結構或操作安全性上的馬赫數上限。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The local Mach number at the point of maximum thickness on a wing is typically {{c1::higher}} than the freestream Mach number.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 機翼最大厚度處的局部馬赫數通常比自由氣流馬赫數還要高。
cloze_items.explanation: 氣流經過凸起物表面時會根據白努利定律或文氏管效應加速。

cloze_items.cloze_text: A {{c1::Mach Cone}} is formed when an aircraft moves at supersonic speeds, with the shockwave detached and trailing behind.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 當飛機以超音速移動且震波脫離機身時，會形成一個『馬赫錐』。
cloze_items.explanation: 這是在超音速區域 (Supersonic region) 震波脫離後的典型物理構造。
